snippet.title: Hell is Us | Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date
snippet.description:
Step into a war-torn country where chaos reigns and mysterious supernatural creatures roam the land. In Hell is Us, uncover the truth behind a conflict fueled by human violence and something far more ancient.

With no map, no compass, and no quest markers, your instincts are your only guide. Explore, observe, and piece together the story at your own pace in a world that refuses to hold your hand.

Fight for survival using brutal melee combat and specialized weapons designed to face the unknown.

Are you ready to face what lies beyond?

Hell is Us is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 September 24, 2026.
